introduction: The Lost Temple of Tikitzopl tells of a resistance against the Krahns and undead. Follow the hidden magician, Zynar's guards' key, four guardian shards and the glass component toward royal treasure and the Orb of Insanity; O'Gallagher and the beautiful drow have separate requests. Item deliveries establish their exact outcomes, while lore, travel, combat and temple liberation need separate evidence. Active, ready accounting is required.
orientation: The temple entrance lies below the Lost City's forest entrance. The foreign temple key opens the approach door; its sacrifice contract remains owned by the Lost City. The magically sealed northern door in the entrance description is scenery: the actual temple route is the hidden trapdoor down.

Look for the hidden chamber beneath the Necromancy temple to meet the crafty magician. Ask about mages, list or help and examine the room journal for the resistance plan. The separate empty Ancient Crypt below the necromancy altar is not his ordinary placement.

The large golem in the hidden passage carries the flaming key for the secret fire-side wall. Krahn'krayv equips the armor of the elements in the Temple of Meditation. Give that exact armor to Zynar at the Altar of Dexterity for the wooden guards' key.

The guards' training grounds contain the master of arms and the glass component. A gem-and-gold key is declared inside a cot in the guards' sleeping chambers and opens the king's chambers. The rack instead contains two yellow vials; its own keyed closure uses that same gem key.

The earth, water, fire and air guardians carry four different shards. Bring one of each plus the glass component to the magician for the golden treasure key. The glass component is a recipe ingredient; a fire shard is different from the separately collected burning flame.

Push the majestic royal altar, then use the golden key for its locked passage down to the treasure rooms. Pushing clears the block but does not itself unlock or reveal all access. This key has a one-percent native break chance; the other local access keys have no native break chance.

Altar inscriptions are clues to the sequence of magical speech doors beyond the treasure rooms. Their accepted last-word keywords differ by door; examined lore and successful unlocking are not recorded as journal achievements. The final southern door is already open in its loaded state.

The Orb is declared inside the marble high altar beyond those doors. Each of fifteen chosen Orb enhancements consumes a separate Orb together with its exact ingredients. One Orb cannot complete every upgrade, and an earlier key or crafting receipt cannot replace a spent current ingredient.

The high altar room also has a separate entrance from Winterhaven's gnomish-key teleport room. Entering its array of lights leads to the Lost City Snake Pit, where a ground leaf key opens the exit. This is a one-way return route with its own encounter, source and travel qualification; hints do not award foreign discovery.

Nine distinct emblems merge into the empowering emblem; nine distinct earrings merge into the Krahns earring. Five sharp stone pieces, ten standard swords, four guard scimitars, five claymores or five base glistening bracelets make separate magical base outputs. Carry every required piece together for the chosen recipe.

Four weather components merge into the basic weathered shard. Four different royal dagger metals and three royal sword metals make their own bases. Those bases can then compete for an Orb; donated exact bases skip earlier producer receipts.

Advanced services also use Lost City equipment: eight distinct racial flesh rings, three different same-named sapphire necklaces and High Council weapons. Necklace sources and attributes distinguish the three kinds. Stocked rings and weapons do not establish personal creature kills or body-part creation.

Return the clover necklace from the drow warrior to O'Gallagher for the mirrored bracelet; give that bracelet to the beautiful drow for mirrored leggings. These two requests remain independent, and donated exact offerings work without the earlier local request.

The high altar prayer is a separate class-change service: it can remove a multiclass character's secondary class and specialization for 100 epic points. Its debit already waits for committed settlement. It grants no quest credit and is not required to retrieve the Orb or craft equipment.

MaDMaN armor can use its worn hide power, the shield has a fire retaliation, the mangler has blur/riposte powers and the mace uses a worn mentality command with a five-minute cooldown. An early mace repeat hurts the wielder. These powers do not complete a takeover, reveal a learned quest keyword or prove accepted combat progress.

Directly carry every exact offering outside equipment and containers. Readiness and journal reads award nothing. Four named requests/story assemblies are potential daily candidates; the 25 equipment services and class-change prayer award no quest achievements or dailies. Fresh active reset stock and actual travel/combat/service episodes still need qualification.

contacts.name: a crafty magician
contacts.description: The crafty magician waits in the hidden chamber beneath the Necromancy temple. Ask about mages, list or help and examine the room journal for the resistance plan. He assembles the treasure key and offers 25 separate equipment services; no implemented takeover finale follows those recipes.

contacts.name: a beautiful drow elf
contacts.description: The beautiful drow at the Altar of Charisma accepts the mirrored bracelet for mirrored leggings. O'Gallagher's earlier request can produce the bracelet, but a supplied one works without that history.

contacts.name: O'Gallagher
contacts.description: O'Gallagher at the Altar of Luck seeks his four-leaf clover necklace, actually equipped by the drow warrior at the Altar of Agility. He supplies a mirrored bracelet, while retaining his own earring and emblem stock.

contacts.name: Zynar
contacts.description: Zynar at the Altar of Dexterity accepts Krahn'krayv's armor of the elements for the wooden guards' key. This is a delivery request, not a tracked rescue, undead purge or retaking of the temple.

contacts.name: a large golem
contacts.description: The large golem in the hidden passage carries the flaming key for the fire-side wall leading to the deeper corridors.

contacts.name: the master of arms
contacts.description: The master of arms in the guards' training grounds carries the delicate glass component required with four elemental shards. That component is not a working key before the magician's assembly.

contacts.name: the guardian of the altar
contacts.description: The earth guardian at the Altar of Earth carries the stone shard. Elemental maze access and personal combat are separate from accepting a supplied shard.

contacts.name: the guardian of the altar

contacts.name: the guardian of the altar

contacts.description: Krahn'krayv equips the armor needed by Zynar or a separate Orb enhancement. One base copy cannot pay both exchanges.

contacts.name: a drow warrior
contacts.description: The drow warrior at the Altar of Agility equips O'Gallagher's clover necklace, an earring and the agility emblem.

contacts.description: Krahn'gon at the Altar of Prayer equips the prayer earring and emblem. His defeat does not automatically record a liberation stage.

contacts.description: Krahn'moor at the Altar of Meditation equips the meditation earring and emblem. The name differs in his long description; his exact stock remains the source lead.

contacts.name: Krahn'ehk, the High Necromancer
contacts.description: Krahn'ehk at the Altar of Necromancy equips the life earring and emblem and has a following pet. Neither the mages nor royal undead are player-triggered transformations.

contacts.name: King Arkan'non
contacts.description: King Arkan'non equips the golden royal sword and his leggings. His undead state is ordinary reset stock, not evidence of a restoration quest.

contacts.name: Queen Arkan'non
contacts.description: Queen Arkan'non equips her royal sleeves. Her throne-room story has no local terminal rescue.

contacts.name: Quilno, the jester

contacts.name: the king's pet
contacts.description: The king's pet guards the first treasure room. Its ordinary placement is independent of key assembly or a recorded personal kill.
